name: Tether USA-T
oneLiner: USAT is Tether's GENIUS-era U.S. dollar stablecoin, issued 1:1 by Anchorage Digital Bank with reserves custodied at Cantor Fitzgerald.
collateral: Cash and reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasuries, held for USAT reserves under Anchorage Digital Bank issuance.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Tether/Anchorage Digital Bank

applicabilityBasis.summary: USAT is publicly described as a U.S. dollar-backed token with 1:1 redemption through Tether and Anchorage Digital Bank, marketed explicitly as a GENIUS Act-compliant payment stablecoin.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank is an uninsured OCC-chartered national trust bank (the first federally chartered crypto bank, chartered January 2021). Under the GENIUS Act, this corresponds to the federal qualified payment stablecoin issuer (FQPSI) pathway supervised by the OCC. Anchorage has submitted a comment letter on the OCC NPRM and publicly states it expects to become a PPSI once the GENIUS Act framework takes effect (rules still in proposed-rulemaking stage as of 2026-06-07). No PPSI approval has been granted to any issuer. The OCC's proposed rule raises a potential 'one issuer, one brand' restriction that could affect Anchorage's white-label model (it currently issues USAT, USDtb/Ethena, USDGO/OSL, and a forthcoming USDPT/Western Union).

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified status, or official GENIUS Act application has been publicly filed or granted for Anchorage Digital Bank or USAT as of 2026-06-07. Anchorage explicitly uses forward-looking language ('expects to become a PPSI') confirming intent, not approval. The GENIUS Act rulemaking remains at the NPRM stage with no final rules issued.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USAT proxies to an implementation that imports WithBlockedList.sol (Tether-family blocked-list/freeze surface) and is upgradeable via a TransparentUpgradeableProxy admin.

mintAuthority.summary: USAT's verified HadronToken source exposes owner-only mint and redeem functions, and live reads resolve the owner to a legacy 3/5 multisig-style contract.

controls.label: USAT owner-only minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294588, the USAT proxy owner() returned this address; required() returned 3 and getOwners() returned five legacy multisig owner slots. Verified HadronToken source exposes mint(address,uint256), redeem(uint256), and destroyBlockedFunds as owner-only functions.

review.evidence: Ethereum reads identified the USAT proxy implementation and a 3/5 multisig-style owner address, while verified HadronToken source confirms owner-only mint and redeem authority. Phase 0c second pass rechecked owner(), required(), and getOwners() at Ethereum block 25294588.
